output.post title: One Real Project Beats Five Tutorial Clones
output.post content:
Stop adding tutorial clones to your GitHub.

When recruiters scan student portfolios, they recognize standard tutorial projects in seconds.

What actually stands out in an internship interview?
1. A problem you picked yourself
2. Trade-offs you had to make (cost, latency, error handling)
3. Clear documentation explaining how it works and what still needs improvement

You don't need 15 repositories. You need 2 or 3 projects you can explain deeply for 10 minutes straight.

What is the one project on your resume you're most proud of explaining?
